extraction.Name: Patsy Robinson—Nee McWilliams
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County (South Dakota) — agency not specified
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 320 acre allotment at the time it was issued; that she had come to the Indian Agency Office to transact some other business; that Mr. Marston told her that her patent was listed among others, and it would be necessary for her to take it, or it would be taxed, and finally sold for taxes if she did not accept it; so when she received it in the mail she took it, although she had protested against it in the first place, as she did not want to pay taxes
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: parted with one quarter of it, to Charlie Lessert, of Merriman, Nebraska, for $1600.00 cash, and a trade consideration in real estate as well
extraction.Buyer: Charlie Lessert, of Merriman, Nebraska, for $1600.00 cash and a trade consideration in real estate
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: kept up the taxes on this allotment up to 1926, when she parted with one quarter of it; she considers that this was really a very poor price for the land, as it is all hay land; but that she made the transfer to even up the acreage of their other lands
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband is a rancher, and that is his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: Deponent states she has never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; mentally competent, has good health; has three children to support; husband has good health and supports her and the three children; children have good health; allotment described as 320 acres, all hay land; document notarized November 26, 1928
